name: Wireshark
blurb: **NOTE: This version of Wireshark does not support capturing data.** Wireshark allows you to examine protocol data stored in files.
description:
**NOTE: This version of Wireshark does not support capturing data.**

Wireshark allows you to examine protocol data stored in files.
It supports dozens of protocol
capture file formats and understands thousands of protocols.

It has many powerful features including a rich display filter language
and the ability to reassemble multiple protocol packets in order to,
for example, view a complete TCP stream, save the contents of a file
which was transferred over HTTP or CIFS, or play back an RTP audio
stream.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
